subtitle: Custom gemstone seals
short_description: Design and order a custom gemstone seal.
full_description: STONE SIGNATURE helps you create a personal seal from natural gemstone. Enter your name, review kanji suggestions, and generate a balanced seal impression from the app.

Choose a one-of-a-kind stone, confirm the design and shipping details, and proceed to secure checkout. Saved designs and preview images stay on your device while payment is handled securely through Stripe.

1.1.0: Added multilingual app content and pilot store metadata source files.
